notes.title: KAKUDO - Update 1.0.0.9

A new patch for KAKUDO is here!

[h1]Release version: 1.0.0.9[/h1]

[h2]Annoncement[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game is now available in russian, dutch, german, portugues & italian!

[list]
[*] Increment version to 1.0.0.8 to 1.0.0.9

[*] Nothing to report.

See you soon!
- Maxim

notes.title: It's time to announce the release date!
notes.notes:
After more than a year of work I am proud to finally announce the release date of KAKUDO!

[b]The game will be released on March 31, 2023 (in less than a month)![/b]

As a reminder, the game will contain [b]50 different levels with 3 game modes[/b] (story, score collect & time attack). In addition to this "arcade" part, the game is carried by a scenario [b]mixing mystery and strangeness.[/b]

Achievement hunters will also be happy to know that [b]33 achievements are available[/b]!

As for the price, the game will be sold at [b]8.99$ with a 15% discoun[/b]t during the launch week (so it will be [b]7.65$[/b])

Anyway, I can't wait to release the game, I hope you'll have as much fun playing it as I was working on it.

See you soon, 
Maxim - WouJy

notes.title: KAKUDO Demo 1.0.7 - Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. [b]The patch 1.0.7[/b] for the KAKUDO demo is now avalaible!

It took a little more time than expected as [b]I rewrote most of the game's UI[/b] to simplify the code and avoid unnecessary things.

At the same time, I [b]optimized the loading[/b] one more time and reduced the size of the game.

Of course, [b]I corrected a few bugs[/b] and took the time to improve a few things.

I got one last thing... [b]Nvidia DLSS is now available[/b]. You can find the parameters under the "display" section.

[h2]Patch notes :[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add time and date to the main menu.
[*]Optimization of the UI code.
[*]HUD has an active camera indicator.
[*]The level 5 haiku is now displayed correctly.
[*]Improved animation of the highlights.
[*]Optimization of the game's loadings.
[*]Enhanced game data containers.
[*]Reduced game size.
[*]Addition of Nvidia DLSS.
[*]Various improvements to be up to date with the future release of the game.
[/list]

See you soon!

- Maxim
